name: Marina de Cudeyo (Spain)
description: White field with a blue diagonal band at the upper hoist and a red diagonal band across the centre from the lower hoist to the upper fly, and a green triangle at the lower fly.
history: Municipal flag of Marina de Cudeyo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: band from the lower hoist to the upper fly
